title: Learn English in NYC | Slow English Vlog

sentences.en: Hello and welcome back to my slow English podcast. Today I will tell you about my trip to New York City, all in slow comprehensible English. Join me today. I am in Rhode Island. I am visiting Rhode Island with my sister Brianna. It is cold outside. It is snowy and cold. I have been sitting here for one hour just taking in the view from my hotel room and journaling while taking in the view. I write in my journal while I take in the winter sun and the peaceful view. The snow is something that I haven't seen in ages. probably since I was 10 years old... I haven't seen the snow. "So nostalgic the feeling of it." So last night I arrived at the airport, and as we stepped outside of the airport, the breeze hit. That was so cold. It's been like 10 years since I've been in a place this cold. "How does my headband look? It looks okay." I couldn't handle that much cold. It was freezing. I was smoking like a chimney! I haven't been to a place this cold since I maybe went to the UK...
